description: Manual Gherkin from the starter, filled in with one scenario.
bodyHtml:
Feature: Login lock

Accounts lock after repeated failed sign-ins.

Scenario: Five failures lock the account

Given an account with no failed attempts

When the tester enters a wrong password five times

Then the lock message is shown
